name: testland/semgrep-rules
description: Use for any question or task about Semgrep, writing a rule that flags a code pattern, or a lighter static analysis (SAST) gate than CodeQL that needs no code database: Registry rulesets and custom YAML rules, semgrep ci with diff-aware baselines, nosemgrep suppressions, path filters, severity filters and JSON, SARIF, GitLab or JUnit output.
